text.what: A dry strip in the rain shadow of the Vosges where nearly everything is white — except pinot noir, the one red grape the appellation allows.
text.today: What used to be pale and often rosé now gets destemmed, barrel-aged and sold as red, and the 2022 rules brought thirteen grand cru sites into play for it. *Tradition holds —* the older bottles were lighter because nobody expected otherwise.

kin.as: The only red the appellation permits.
Its grey sibling, grown on the same slopes.
Across the Rhine, the same climate under another flag.
